summary.text: Jim Dunnigan is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 36 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Taylorsville resident, he previously owned an insurance brokerage and served on the Taylorsville City Council.

paragraphs.text: Jim Dunnigan earned a B.S. in business management from the University of Utah in 1976, according to Ballotpedia.
He was the owner and insurance broker of Dunnigan Insurance from 1976 to 2004.
Dunnigan was a Republican state delegate from 1990 to 1992 and served on the Taylorsville-Bennion Community Council from 1991 to 1996.
He served on the Taylorsville City Council from 1996 to 2002 and as a county delegate from 2002 to 2004.
In the 2021-2022 legislative term he chaired the Political Subdivisions Committee.
